description: This Python source file defines a custom SSO handler for integration with an Identity Provider (IDP), used within the Litellm proxy project. It implements an async function that processes IDP info, retrieves user data from the database, and returns a structured user value object.

classes.name: SSOUserDefinedValues
classes.description: A data class representing the custom values for an SSO user, including roles, email, user ID, and budget information.

classes.name: LitellmUserRoles
classes.description: An enumeration for user roles within Litellm, e.g., INTERNAL_USER.

methods.name: SSOUserDefinedValues custom_sso_handler(userIDPInfo: OpenID)
methods.description: An async function handling custom SSO logic, retrieving user info from IDP and database, and returning user-defined values.
